resources.string: Real location not known yet. Turn off the fake location once so the app can read your GPS.
Showing your last real location (fake location is on)

Android only lets one app fake the location.

1. Open Settings → About phone → Software information and tap "Build number" 7 times to enable Developer options.
2. Open Developer options → "Select mock location app" and choose Fake Location.
3. Come back and try again.
Developer options are off. Enable them first (tap Build number 7 times).
